id.description: Canonical C3 Identifier for this Cloud Resource in the format of <cluster>-<env>-<app>-<func>[-<role>]-<seq>[-<subseq>].

env.description:
C3 Environment name (second) component in {@link #id}; e.g. srv,ui,c3.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> c3
An Environment name must be unique within a Cluster.

app.description:
C3 Application name (third) component in {@link #id}; e.g. c3,crm,lightbulb
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> crm
An Application name must be unique within an Environment.

role.description:
C3 role; e.g. m, w; cannot be number only.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> l

@see CloudResource#cloudRoles

seq.description:
Sequence number - should only contain numbers - it is recommended to have fixed number of digits for a
`<func>-<role>` with 0 left padding so that list of resources are naturally ordered; can be 2, 3, 4 or 5 digits.
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-l-0001
=> 0001

@see CloudResource#cloudSeqLength

subseq.description:
Sub-sequence alphanumeric string (dot allowed)
E.g. prod-c3-crm-app-t-0001-kk03
=> 001

resourceId.description: Cloud service provider generated native ID, such as vpcId and securityGroupId.

resourceSecondaryId.description: Cloud service provider generated native secondary ID, such as Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

resourceName.description: User defined name attribute managed by cloud service provider.

resourceGroupName.description: ResourceGroup for Azure resources and K8s namespaces

fullyConfigured.description:
When true, CloudResource will GET from locally persisted Config framework
When false, CloudResource will GET from remote Cloud APIs

resourceNamespace.description: resourceNamespace for K8s Resources (only those which are associated with a namespace)

external.description:
This flag indicates that this cloud resource managed by third party, C3 will not create or destroy this resource
implicitly.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

nativeMetricByName.description:
This table has logical metrics as keys and native metrics as values.
For example, 'cpu' could map to native metric 'CPUUTILIZATION' for {@link AwsEc2Instance}

tags.description: Cloud tags assigned to this resource.

description.description: Customized description for the cloud resource.

parentResource.description: Parent Cloud Resource that this children cloud resource belongs to

endpoint.description: The service endpoint used by Redis/Memcached clients to connect.

engine.description: AwsElastiCache supports Redis cluster and Memcached

engineVersion.description:
Engine version. For latest supported versions visit
http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/UserGuide/SelectEngine.MemcachedVersions.html - Memcached
http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/UserGuide/SelectEngine.RedisVersions.html - Redis

parameterGroupName.description:
Parameters can be grouped into parameter groups and assigned during cluster creation. You can either create your a
new group or use the ones provided by AWS.
http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/UserGuide/ParameterGroups.html

nodeType.description: The node type. For Redis cluster, Multi-AZ and automatic failover is not supported for nodeTypes T1 and T2

numNodes.description:
This is a memcahed only parameter and will be ignored for Redis cluster operations.

Number of nodes that constitute the cluster. For 40 GB cache, you may choose 13 `cache.t2.medium` nodes.

numShards.description:
This is a Redis only parameter and will be ignored for Memcached cluster operations.

The number of shards (partitions) you want for this Redis cluster. In Redis once you create the cluster the number
of shards is fixed and cannot be changed. If you find you need more or fewer  shards, you must create a new cluster
with the new number of shards.

If the `numShards` value is 1 then we consider the redis cluster to be `cluster-mode disabled` and when the value
is > 1, then the redis cluster is `cluster-mode enabled`.

readReplicasPerShard.description:
This is a Redis only parameter and will be ignored for Memcached cluster operations.

The number of read replica nodes you want in each shard. The number of read replicas per shard is fixed and cannot
be changed. If you find you need more or fewer replicas per shard, you must create a new cluster with the new
number of replicas.

subnetGroupName.description: The name of the subnet group that is associated with the cluster.

availabilityZone.description: The availability zone in which the service is running.

securityGroupIds.description: A list of VPC Security Groups to be associated with the cluster.

isMultiAz.description: Specifies if the ElastiCache cluster is a Multi-AZ deployment.

preferredMaintenanceWindow.description:
The weekly time range during which system maintenance can occur, in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).
Must be in the format ddd:hh24:mi-ddd:hh24:mi. Times should be in Universal Coordinated Time (UTC).
Valid Days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun
Must be at least 30 minutes window

title:
AwsElastiCache is a fast in-memory KV store with Redis and Memcached as the supported engines. AwsElastiCache type
provides APIs to perform cluster operations like create, reboot and delete.
name: AwsElastiCache
